{{Quote|I'd like to pass on the hot tub&hellip;just for a little while. I was on my way back to the main ballroom to catch the next show.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="M77">[[Star Wars (1977) 77|''Star Wars'' (1977) 77]]</ref>}}
A '''hot tub''' was a heated [[Bath/Legends|bath]] used for relaxation. Some [[Sauna/Legends|saunas]] were used together with hot tubs. The suites on [[Kabray Station]] contained hot tubs for guests' comfort,<ref name="M77" /> as did the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on [[Rorkee]].<ref name="LF">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds}}</ref>
